summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated 727KB sibling payload
details: @onereach/idw-apps@0.1.5 declares a preinstall lifecycle hook (`node setup.mjs`) that runs automatically on `npm install`. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from GitHub releases (pinned to bun-v1.3.13), makes it executable in a temp directory, and uses it to execute a sibling file `math_init.js` from the tarball root. math_init.js is a ~727 KB single-line file with hex-mangled identifiers, a large constant string pool, and a string-array rotation function characteristic of obfuscator.io-style loaders. The filename bears no relation to the package's stated MCP iframe-bridging purpose. Both setup.mjs and math_init.js are shipped at the tarball root outside the `files: ["dist", "skills"]` manifest declared in package.json, yet are executed at install time. The alternate-runtime pattern (executing an opaque payload under a freshly-downloaded Bun rather than Node) bypasses Node-focused install-time scanners. Contents of the executed blob cannot be audited without running the deobfuscator.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
